### wallet_ext_resend_charge (target tool charge_resend_fee_8300b1da, agent)
- Hub `resend_charge_entry`: situation sentence (booked when the customer instructs a resend; retry_fee entry dated the day of the instruction, from the original funding method, numbered with the resend's number) = rule sentence 1; tool effect, owner (agent, "not handed to the customer"), parameters and return = task_tools.py. Hub carries no factor, no composition, no figure.
- Computation doc `resend_charge_calculation`: baseline.rule (numbering = credit-sent entries, opening resend number 1; not above free_retries → no charge; above → the tier's retry fee) + "booked even when its charge comes to 0.00" + assembly clause 4 (the replaced_by sentence: one product on the same figure, rounded half up once) + clause 5 (collected from the original funding method; the figure so collected is booked). Product figures named ("the tier's free retries", "the tier's retry fee"). Fall-back: 2.99. Equivalent.
- Factors (whole ladders, all tiers):
  - charge_form → `resend_charge_principal_bands`: ≥1500.00 → 0.25 % rounded; 1000.00–<1500.00 → retry fee + 0.10 % (percentage part rounded); <1000.00 → retry fee flat; edges stated both sides. Exact.
  - cause_share → `bounce_cause_charge_share`: provider unavailable 0; wallet limit exceeded / wallet suspended 0.80; any other recipient-side cause 1; "latest" = most recent reversed-credit entry. Exact.
  - account_standing_relief → `sender_account_standing_relief`: Enhanced+ (level ≥4) & ≥24 whole months 1.00; Verified Plus (level 3) & ≥24 0.50; otherwise none; both parts of the compound condition and both tenure sides shown. Exact.
  - bank_deposit_relief → `bank_deposit_volume_relief`: 6-month rolling window with the whole-month rule; ≥3000.00 0.30; 1000.00–<3000.00 0.15; less none; names Bank Deposit and "funds-received entries". Exact.
  - bounce_taper → `repeat_bounce_taper`: ≥3 → ×0.70; exactly 2 → ×0.85; single → whole; counts every reversed credit. Exact.
  - collection_route → `resend_charge_collection_by_funding_method`: credit card (card funding fee entry) → ×(1 + pct/100) rounded; pay-by-bank → minus discount, floor 0.00; debit/ACH/wire → as it stands. Exact.
- prerequisite: none declared.

### wallet_ext_resend_credit (target tool resend_failed_credit_8d2e2e1a, agent)
- Hub `bounced_credit_resend`: situation (credit failed, customer instructs a resend to the same wallet, transfer returns to processing) = rule sentence 1; tool effect/owner/parameters/return = task_tools.py.
- **Prerequisite edge → wallet_ext_resend_charge, form state.** policy_source "For a resend beyond the tier's free resends, the amount it credits is fixed only after the charge assessed for that resend stands on the transfer's ledger." — verbatim in the hub's "Prerequisite clause" (blocked policy's own hub), ordering connective "only after" intact; same-form restatement "where the resend's number is above the tier's free resends, the amount to be credited is not settled while no charge for that resend is recorded on the transfer's ledger" (still a state, no action/tool named). Resolution basis: the depended-on hub `resend_charge_entry` describes its own write in the state's words ("Once booked, the resend charge stands on the transfer's ledger as that resend-charge entry"); records: c8080fce has 2 credit-sent entries, Express free retries 1, no retry_fee entry. Strength: hard gate in source and KB. Not carried by any other policy's document (grep of the corpus for "fixed only", "assessed for that resend": only this hub).
- Computation doc `resend_amount_and_conversion`: baseline.rule (principal held = funds-received + reversed + Paloma credits − sent − refunds; one new credit-sent entry, attempt = sent + 1; processing, released now, date available resend day; converts at locked rate, amount rounded half up 2) + the replaced_by assembly (uplifts summed, locked rate × (1 + sum/100) rounded 4, amount rounded 2). Fall-back 71468.03. Equivalent.
- Factors: paid_resend_uplift → `paid_resend_rate_uplift` (≥ tier retry fee 0.20; >0 and < retry fee 0.10; 0.00 or none nothing; per-tier retry-fee table; the 0.00-retry-fee consequence derived correctly from the compute order); held_days_clock → `resend_waiting_period_start` (all provider-unavailable → booking date; ≥2 bounces with ≥1 recipient-side → first bounce (attempt-1 reversal); otherwise date part of failed_at); held_days_uplift → `held_days_rate_uplift` (≥14 0.30; 7–<14 0.15; <7 nothing); principal_uplift → `principal_size_rate_uplift` (≥1500.00 0.10; 1000.00–<1500.00 0.05; less nothing); cash_pickup_uplift → `cash_pickup_activity_uplift` (6-month rolling, ≥1000.00 0.10; 300.00–<1000.00 0.05; names Cash Pickup funds-received entries). All exact.

### wallet_ext_shortfall_recredit (target tool choose_shortfall_recredit_f54302ef, owner user)
- Hub `shortfall_recredit_remedy`: situation (error found on an incorrect-amount notice, customer may choose re-credit to the same wallet) and the tool effect; invocation "The agent unlocks … and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it" = owner user.
- **Prerequisite edge → wallet_ext_shortfall_makegood, form state.** "The amount a shortfall re-credit delivers is fixed only after Paloma's own shortfall credit stands on the transfer's ledger." — verbatim in the hub's "Conditions"; restated in the same form ("while Paloma's own shortfall credit is not yet on the transfer's ledger, the amount the re-credit would deliver is not settled"). Resolution basis: `shortfall_make_good_credit` "Once booked, Paloma's own shortfall credit stands on the transfer's ledger"; records: no Paloma credit on b83fe068, error_found decision present. Strength equal; no other document carries it.
- **Prerequisite edge → wallet_ext_resend_credit, form state.** "A shortfall re-credit is not sent to a wallet until no earlier-booked transfer of the same customer addressed to that wallet number stands with a failed credit." — verbatim in the same "Conditions", connective "until" intact; same-form restatement ("while any transfer of the same customer booked before this one and addressed to the same wallet number still stands with a failed credit, the shortfall re-credit does not go to that wallet"). Resolution basis: `bounced_credit_resend` describes, in the sentence's words, the write that ends the state ("the transfer stands with a failed credit (status credit failed) … the transfer moves from credit failed back to processing"); records: c8080fce credit_failed, booked 2026-09-21, wallet 09178524416. Strength: hard gate in both. Not carried elsewhere (grep "earlier-booked", "booked before": hub only). The depended-on resend documents do not mention the shortfall re-credit.
- Computation doc `shortfall_recredit_conversion`: baseline.rule (choice is the customer's own, recorded against the notice; sends whole principal held as one credit-sent entry, attempt = sent + 1; processing/released/date available; converts at the locked rate) + replaced_by assembly ("starts from the transfer's locked rate as its base rate and is raised by re-credit points …") + the non-factor terms locked rate, principal collected, margin carried. Fall-back definite. Equivalent.
- Factors: shortfall_rate_basis → `shortfall_recredit_base_rate` (applied below locked → locked ÷ (1 − margin/100) r4; applied equal and delivered less than disclosed → locked × (1 + 0.5 × margin/100) r4; otherwise locked; margin definition); level_points → `account_level_points` (≥4 0.30; 3 0.15; lower nothing); pickup_points → `cash_pickup_payout_points` (12-month rolling payout-made entries, ≥4 0.20; 2–<4 0.10; <2 nothing); deposit_points → `bank_deposit_payout_points` (12-month payout-sent entries, ≥6 0.20; 3–<6 0.10; <3 nothing); size_points → `shortfall_recredit_size_points` (principal held when sent ≥25.00 0.20; 10.00–<25.00 0.10; <10.00 nothing). All exact.

## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION PASS** (task 0). Revision 1; no earlier revision.

Policy-side notes (recorded, not KB verdicts):
- N1. `parameter_schema.retry_fee_usd` ("Fee (USD) for each customer-requested retry beyond the free ones after a sender-side failure") restates, as the meaning of the parameter, the semantics of the clause `wallet_ext_resend_charge` retired; `failed_credit_allowances` carries that schema description faithfully ("The retry fee is the fee for each customer-requested retry beyond the free ones after a sender-side failure"). It is consistent with the new basis's figure (the tariff's charge figure is the tier's retry fee) but describes it in the retired basis's words.
- N2. The overwrite retiring "A retried or redirected credit uses the transfer's original fx_rate and receive_amount …" covers redirects too, while the three replacing policies give a conversion basis for resends and error re-credits only; after the retirement no source sentence fixes the rate of a redirected credit. Untriggered in this difficulty.
- N3. Three factors take as input a date decided by another factor (held_days_uplift ← held_days_clock; delay_goodwill ← shortfall_clock; misdirection_goodwill ← misdirect_clock). The source places each start rule in its own factor and gives the clock's baseline (failed_at / notice date) only in authoring fields, so the uplift/goodwill document names its input as "the starting date of its wait" / "the starting date of the shortfall period" and a reader who finds it without the clock document has no stated start. This is the source's factor decomposition, faithfully rendered.

## dependency_form

Scan of the whole wallet corpus (63 docs) against the four edges, using the blind answer's hop marks (all three task-0 hops state-derived, none pre-solved):
- Each prerequisite sentence stands verbatim in its blocked policy's hub (`bounced_credit_resend`; `shortfall_recredit_remedy` ×2) and in no other document; the same-form restatements beside them keep the state form and name no action, performer, problem or tool.
- No document names another problem's tool: each of the six tool names occurs only in its own hub (grep).
- No route, ordered step list, dependency table, checklist or aggregated chain across problems; no "first … then"; no "if unmet, call …"; no FAQ/example walking across problems; no wrong-vs-right contrast or named mistake.
- Depended-on documents are reachable through record words and the sentences' own state words ("stands on the transfer's ledger", "failed credit / credit failed", "resend charge"), not only through phrasing borrowed from the dependent hub; they do not disclose who waits on them.
- Titles/openings are general subjects (e.g. "Mobile Wallet Shortfall Re-Credit Remedy: Customer Hand-Over Card", "Mobile Wallet Bounced-Credit Resend: Payments Desk Tool Card", "Resend Charge Entries on Mobile Wallet Transfers: Tool Reference"); none restates this customer's request or situation.
- Factor documents: none says which tier a customer or most customers fall on, none writes a task's evidence rows as fact, none names the computation document or another factor document. The goodwill/uplift documents name their input date quantity in the rule's words (N3), which is the input the source assigns them, not a pointer.
- Computation documents: none carries "unless", "adjustments may apply", "certain customers", "elsewhere", an exception list or a pointer. They do carry the source's own assembly sentence (the declared `overwrite.replaced_by` of each policy), rendered generically — tariff clause 4 "every share of it the customer bears, every relief taken off it … and every taper on it multiplies that same figure"; "Uplift points raise the locked rate for a resend …"; "Goodwill percentages and goodwill amounts are added to the shortfall make-good …"; "is raised by re-credit points" — plus non-factor terms that only factors consume ("Margin the transfer carried", the notice/decision "Dates on record"). These are the assembly and the non-factor bindings the source assigns to the computation document; they name no factor, no qualifying customer and no document, and the fall-back stays definite (2.99 / 55.8344 / 10.66 / 55.9819). Recorded as an observation, not a finding.
